Featured.title: Get Verified
Featured.subtitle: Everything on ouiKnow is free — browsing, matching and messaging. Verified is optional: you get the blue check next to your name, and your profile shows at the top of everyone's lists, regardless of match score.
Featured.perk1: Your profile appears first, above the scored matches, for every person of the other role
Featured.perk2: The blue Verified check next to your name, everywhere it shows
Featured.perk3: More visibility, not a better match score — the matching stays honest

Featured.step2: In the transfer note, put your account email:
